prompt: I want to clone the Stripe homepage so I can run it locally for design reference. I've got Playwright MCP set up. How should I approach this?
assertions: Recommends Playwright DOM capture (document.documentElement.outerHTML) over wget or HTTrack
Mentions searching JS files for CDN base URL variables, not just grepping for full URLs
Warns about referrer-protected CDNs and recommends verifying file sizes (e.g. wc -c)
Recommends using absolute paths (/css/, /js/) rather than relative paths
Covers multiple phases of the cloning process in logical order
Mentions repairing Playwright JSON pipeline corruption artifacts
